FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 282
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility & Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Jay Hovey
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/08/2024
Senate Bill 282 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund, increase
receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other
funds to which court costs are deposited, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
number of violations issued and the penalties imposed.
In addition, this bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency and the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources to notify the
public of the requirements and prohibitions provided by this act.
